name: legends-astro
title: Astro v7 Site Migrations, Build Parity Checks & Knowledge Vault
summary: Audit legacy HTML, WordPress XML/JSON, or Firecrawl exports into a migration contract, scaffold Astro v7 Content Layer collections, verify dist/ build parity, and query pinned Astro v7 docs.
Outcomes: Convert a WordPress site, static HTML tree, or Firecrawl scrape to Astro v7 without losing routes, SEO metadata, JSON-LD schema, or client JS DOM IDs
Verify an Astro project runtime, local binary, lockfile, and Astro v7 Content Layer structure before building
Mechanically verify built dist/ HTML against a source migration contract and check that draft content entries never leak into production
Search pinned official Astro v7 MDX documentation offline or check live upstream npm and withastro/docs drift
Attach the Astro v7 operational knowledge pack to an Empire Markdown vault
examples: Convert my WordPress export or static HTML pages to an Astro v7 site and verify parity
Check why my Astro v7 build broke client scripts, styles, trailing slashes, or content collections
Audit an existing site before migrating to Astro and verify the built dist folder afterward
not_for: Provisioning cloud servers, reverse proxies, or DNS records
Executing untrusted astro.config.mjs files during read-only inspection
